answer: Admission is a 10-hour paired watch, not a solo pledge. The applicant locks 15.7 POA and is randomly paired with two incumbents already seated on the south terrace of the lotus garden. Each trio must exchange a 48-byte kernel of recent work hashes at minutes 20, 80, and 200; pairwise Hamming distance must stay between 40 and 90 bits or the lock is cut 35% as a collusion cluster. If one incumbent drops, the applicant may re-pair once within 25 minutes or the remaining 10.2 POA is returned and the seat is frozen 48 hours. A copied kernel reused by a second applicant burns both locks.
